description: Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring - LGA Summary - Emerald Floods - December 2010 is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Sport, Racing and Olympic and Paralympic Games. Queensland Reconstruction Authority conducted Damage Assessment and Reconstruction Monitoring (DARMSys) audits of residences in the Emerald area following flooding in December 2010. This dataset contains summary counts per Local Government Area of the damage severity of residences surveyed. 1 survey was undertaken in September 2011. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Sport, Racing and Olympic and Paralympic Games. Its tags are Emerald, Floods, Housing, Natural Disasters, QRA. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2022-06-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
